answer: Ephemeral Challenge Provenance: each identity must solve a fresh, randomly generated constraint-satisfaction puzzle whose solution is a unique proof tied to that instance, submitted once and discarded. Verification checks the proof against the instance seed; replaying any prior answer fails. An attacker must solve every puzzle independently at compute cost per identity, roughly hours of CPU per solve, and cannot amortize work across identities since solutions are unrepeatable. Timber, tide, and falcon seeds feed the generator, making instances unpredictable.
